w: At 11.22 am Swamishri arrived at the New York mandir. In the evening Dr. Subramaniyam and his team of doctors who had performed Swamishri's bypass surgery came to see him. They were honored and welcomed during the assembly.
After his morning puja, Swamishri performed pujan of a murti of Shri Ganeshji.

At 10.20 a.m., Swamishri performed the pujan of kalashas (golden pots) to be installed on the newly built Swaminarayan mandir shikhars and domes. The ceremony was performed with Vedic rites and elation. Swamishri then blessed the assembly, saying, "...whatever we do for such religious activities will bear fruits. Your life is crowned with kalashas through your contribution and cooperation for this occasion..." Finally the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees.

The festival assembly commenced after Swamishri's morning puja with the speeches of Pujya Dr.Swami and Pujya Viveksagar Swami. A traditional dance by balaks added to the festive flair of the celebration. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly of 13,000 devotees, saying, "God protects us from the harassment of someone, from a disease and from political, social, legal, business or family problems. But the important thing is that He protects us from the cycle of life and death and the inner enemies. This is what we should ask of Him..." Thereafter, the devotees had Swamishri's darshan and the senior sadhus gave them sanctified rakhadis. Lunch (prasad) was served to all devotees.

The mahant of Pejavar Math, HH Swami Vishveshtirthji, arrived at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir. Swamishri welcomed him with a garland and a shawl. Pujya Vishveshtirthji narrated his vivid impressions of Swaminarayan Akshardham and said that he was impressed by the life of Bhagwan Swaminarayan.

Prior to the vastu pravesh ritual ceremony (sanctification of mandir) Swamishri performed pujan of the kalashes and flagstaffs and then showered rice grains and flowers and performed arti . Thereafter the vastu pravesh rituals were performed beneath the mandir done by Tyagvallabh Swami, Ishwarcharan Swami, Viveksagar Swami and senior devotees.
How to Become 'Thorn-Proof'

18 August 2007, Atlanta Two teenage satsangi boys prayed to Swamishri, “Bapa, give us such slippers to wear so that no thorns of this world can pierce through.” Swamishri replied, “That’s right. But if you see television programmes then stop it, otherwise the thorns will pierce you. Do not eat meat, and food in hotels and restaurants. If you observe this much then no thorns will pierce you. But when you indulge in all things and then come and say the ‘thorns’ (have pierced through and) are hurting you – then what else can be done!” For spiritual progress and happiness observance of niyams are essential and indispensable.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
17 August 2007, ATLANTA
Jyotsnaben Patel of Perry has been taking only one meal daily since 2006 for Swamishri’s good health. 100 yuvatis of the Southeast region observed 100-hr liquid fasts.
21 August 2007, ATLANTA
Shailesh, Amit and Ravi of Atlanta have been offering their voluntary services for the mandir festival and observing liquid fasts for the last three months.
22 August 2007, ATLANTA
84 women devotees of Tampa mandal have been observing chain-fasts since the celebration of Swamishri’s 84th birthday (2004).
25-31 August 2007, ATLANTA

During Swamishri’s breakfast and meal times brief reports on satsang activities were presented by volunteers from different centres: Rome, Chattanooga, Florence, Columbia, Birmingham, Augusta and Orangeburg.

A spiritual seeker phoned. When he was small, he and a friend had brought home the chicks of a lapwing. Their only aim was to play with the chicks, but after taking them up to the terrace, a chick fell and died. Even after growing up he cannot forget this, he keeps feeling sad about it, and he feels that because of it he does not succeed in anything he does.

Having listened to him, Pramukh Swami Maharaj consoled him and said, "You did not do this on purpose, and in your mind you have already atoned for whatever happened. So now do not believe that the chick died because of you. Its lifespan must have been only that long! Its lifespan must have come to an end, so it must have died! So there is no need to believe, 'This happened because of me.' God has made creation like that, so it must have happened that way! Pray to God, do bhajan, turn five malas, and there will be happiness and peace."
The seeker said, "Please be my guru birth after birth."
Swamishri said, "Since you have faith, keep the refuge of God firm."
The seeker said, "I have kalsarp yog (an inauspicious planetary combination). The Brahmin says I should do 11 lakh (1.1 million) chants."
Swamishri said, "Since you have the refuge of God, keep it firm and turn the mala of the Swaminarayan mahamantra and do puja. Recite the Janmangal five times, and God will make everything good."

ds.t: Memories of Pramukh Swami Maharaj for the press
w: Various media wished to receive a message from Mahant Swami Maharaj as the successor of Pramukh Swami Maharaj and the sixth spiritual successor of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. For this, today before his midday meal, Swamishri came onto the stage of the "Pramukh Darshan Vatika".

Here, on behalf of all the journalists, Swamishri was asked, "You have been watching Pramukh Swami Maharaj for years. You have had his company since 1951, so would you tell us one or two memorable incidents of his that you experienced during this time, which show his greatness?"
Swamishri answered:

"This was about sixty years ago. Yogibapa commanded me, 'Travel with Pramukh Swami Maharaj for four days, then come and see me.' So I joined him as his attendant. One day we reached the railway station to go from Ahmedabad to Anand.

"The third class compartment was very crowded. So Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, 'I will go ahead and make arrangements, then you come.' I was the attendant; it was I who should have made the arrangements, but he went. He made the arrangements. Then we went there.

"After a while Swamibapa asked me, 'Where is your bag?' I had forgotten it in that other compartment. But Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, 'You sit, I'll bring it.' Who was the attendant? I sat there, and yet he did not say a single word.

"I was among the youths. He had every right to scold me. In such a situation, even the most patient person would get irritated. In this incident patience, spirituality, forgiveness, everything is included.

"Pramukh Swami Maharaj was the very embodiment of virtue. Wherever you put your hand, you would find only virtue. We had not realised that Swamishri had such great influence and such affection from people. For four days the stream of devotees for darshan of his divine body went on and on! Not even a second went empty. Everyone felt, 'Swami is sitting in meditation; he will speak now... he will speak now...' Everyone has great feeling for him."
Thus Swamishri wove a garland of his guru's virtues.
Here are some special incidents from the personal meetings Mahant Swami Maharaj gave today.
A devotee named Kanubhai came. Swamishri himself reminded him that he had stayed at his home in 1977.
Bharatbhai (Kampala), son of R. U. Patel, a devotee from Shastriji Maharaj's time, came. Swamishri said, "I stayed at your home for a month."
Dharmeshbhai, a devotee from the village of Vandarvela who has settled here, came. Swamishri said, "We have stayed at your home many times."
An American devotee named Kevin came. He holds a good position at the UN. Knowing Swamishri's interest, he asked, "How can there be international unity?"
Swamishri said, "Start with the family, and it will happen at the international level."
Another devotee came. There are endless problems in his home... the pots have clashed so much that people are no longer speaking to each other.
Giving a solution, Swamishri said, "Start ghar sabha."
Overwhelmed at seeing Swamishri's memory in these meetings, Aksharvandandas Swami said, "You do not even need to use your power of knowing all hearts; you remember so many devotees and so much!"
Swamishri said, "I remember a great many more, but there is no time to say it."
That means that what Swamishri says is only a tiny fraction.

Today, before going to the assembly, Mahant Swami Maharaj drank some water. To wipe his mouth, Shwetmunidas Swami gave him a whole tissue. Swamishri hesitated and did not take it... He looked around. There a used tissue was lying... He picked it up. The sadhus said, "Hmm... hmm... that is the tissue with the chandlo (red forehead mark) on it..." Still Swamishri was ready to use it. Accepting the wish and request of Shwetmunidas Swami and the sadhus, he took the big tissue, but said, "I feel uneasy using a whole one!!"
